decision_conditions: The proposed first floor rear extension, by reason of its bulk, mass, scale and detailed design would appear visually intrusive, incongruous, overly dominant would be out of keeping with the character and appearance of the surrounding area, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), DMD6, DMD8, DMD11 and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed ground floor rear extension, by reason of its excessive depth, scale and proximity to the shared boundary with No. 72 Uvedale Road, would give rise to an unneighbourly form of development resulting in an unacceptable loss of outlook, increased sense of enclosure and reduction in daylight and sunlight to the neighbouring occupiers. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD 8 and DMD 11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed first floor rear extension, by reason of its excessive depth, scale and proximity to the shared boundary with Nos. 1- 29 Princessa Court, would give rise to an unneighbourly form of development resulting in an unacceptable loss of outlook, increased sense of enclosure and reduction in daylight and sunlight to the neighbouring occupiers. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D4 of the London Plan (2021), CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD 8 and DMD 11 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed development, in the absence of an adequate flood risk assessment, fails to demonstrate how proposed measures manage the risk of flooding contrary to Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies SI.12 and SI.13 of the London Plan, Policies CP21 and CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy, Policies DMD60 and DMD61 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Erection of an additional storey with room in roof space and part single, part 2 storey side extension and 2 storey rear extension.
